WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
),
avg1_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg1
  FROM actor_counts
),
filtered1 AS (
  SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count
  FROM actor_counts ac
  WHERE ac.actor_count > (SELECT avg1 FROM avg1_val)
    AND (SELECT avg1 FROM avg1_val) IS NOT NULL
),
avg2_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg2
  FROM filtered1
),
filtered2 AS (
  SELECT f1.film_id, f1.actor_count
  FROM filtered1 f1
  WHERE f1.actor_count > (SELECT avg2 FROM avg2_val)
    AND (SELECT avg2 FROM avg2_val) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  SUM(actor_count) AS total_actor_count,
  AVG(actor_count - (SELECT avg1 FROM avg1_val)) AS avg_excess_over_first_average,
  AVG(actor_count - (SELECT avg2 FROM avg2_val)) AS avg_excess_over_second_average
FROM filtered2
